textbookText: If compound AC is used to removed the acidity of soil and BC₂ is produced when AB𝐶3 reacts with HCl. Name the compound AB𝐶3 & write the balanced chemical reaction according to above mentioned symbol. Ans:- Given Information: AC is used to remove the acidity of soil. This indicates that AC is likely Calcium Oxide (CaO) or Calcium Carbonate (CaCO₃), which are commonly used to neutralize acidic soil. BC₂ is produced when ABC₃ reacts with HCl. This suggests the presence of CO₂ (Carbon Dioxide) as BC₂.Thus, ABC₃ is Calcium Carbonate (CaCO₃). The balance chemical reaction according to above mentioned symbol is CaCO₃ -----∆------> CaO + CO₂
